_note: Round 3 (2026-11-13): 10 male + 10 female designed voices for Broadcast's voice library. Each voice is designed once from its description (VoiceDesign, ref_text below), then both test lines are cloned from that one clip (Base), the production workflow, so what Matthew hears is what a video gets.
ref_text: Here's something most people never notice. It happens every day, right above our heads, and almost nobody stops to ask why.

lines.name: Hook
lines.text: Every night, while you sleep, your brain replays your day. And then it does something strange with it.

lines.name: Explainer
lines.text: The river didn't carve the canyon all at once. It cut a few millimetres a year, for six million years.

male.name: Documentary narrator
male.design: A deep, warm American male voice in his fifties, like a nature documentary narrator. Measured, rich and calm, with a sense of wonder. Unhurried pace with natural pauses.

male.name: Curious explainer
male.design: A bright, engaged American male voice in his late twenties, like a popular science YouTuber explaining something fascinating. Curious and lively, clear, conversational, medium pace.

male.name: Close and quiet
male.design: A soft, intimate American male voice in his thirties, very close to the microphone, almost a hush. Gentle, slow and calm, like telling a secret late at night.

male.name: High-energy creator
male.design: An energetic young American male voice in his early twenties, a social media creator hooking viewers. Punchy, fast and excited, but clear and natural, not shouting.

male.name: Cinematic trailer
male.design: A very deep, resonant American male voice in his forties, like a movie trailer narrator. Dramatic, slow and powerful, with weight on each phrase.

male.name: Friendly founder
male.design: A casual, upbeat American male voice in his thirties, a friendly tech founder showing off something he built. Warm, relaxed, smiling, conversational.

male.name: British documentary
male.design: A calm, articulate British male voice in his forties with a standard southern English accent, like a BBC documentary presenter. Thoughtful, precise and warm.

male.name: Gravelly storyteller
male.design: An older American male voice in his sixties, slightly gravelly and raspy, wise and kind, like a grandfather telling a story by the fire. Slow and warm.

male.name: Crisp analyst
male.design: A crisp, neutral American male voice in his thirties, precise and confident like a news anchor explaining data. Clear diction, steady pace, no drama.

male.name: Relaxed Australian
male.design: A relaxed, warm Australian male voice in his late twenties with a natural Australian accent. Easygoing, friendly and conversational, medium pace.

female.name: Documentary narrator
female.design: A rich, warm American female voice in her forties, like a nature documentary narrator. Measured and calm with a sense of wonder. Unhurried pace with natural pauses.

female.name: Curious explainer
female.design: A bright, engaged American female voice in her late twenties, like a popular science YouTuber explaining something fascinating. Curious and lively, clear, conversational, medium pace.

female.name: Close and quiet
female.design: A soft, intimate American female voice in her thirties, very close to the microphone, almost a whisper. Gentle, slow and soothing, like telling a secret late at night.

female.name: High-energy creator
female.design: A lively young American female voice in her early twenties, a social media creator hooking viewers. Fast, excited and expressive, but clear and natural, not shrill.

female.name: Low and mysterious
female.design: A low, smoky American female voice in her thirties, slow and suspenseful, like narrating a mystery. Calm, controlled, a little dark.

female.name: Crisp professional
female.design: A clear, confident American female voice in her thirties, precise like a news anchor explaining a story. Crisp diction, steady pace, warm but professional.

female.name: British presenter
female.design: A calm, articulate British female voice in her thirties with a standard southern English accent, like a BBC science presenter. Thoughtful, warm and precise.

female.name: Warm storyteller
female.design: An older American female voice in her sixties, kind and wise, like a grandmother telling a story. Slow, warm and gentle, with a slight smile.

female.name: Playful friend
female.design: An upbeat, playful American female voice in her mid twenties, smiling while she talks, like telling a friend something cool she just learned. Casual and natural.

female.name: Relaxed Australian
female.design: A relaxed, friendly Australian female voice in her late twenties with a natural Australian accent. Easygoing, warm and conversational, medium pace.
